2609.09984.title: Multi-Functional Embedding Models for Funder Name Disambiguation in Scientific Publication Records
2609.09984.paper_summary: Understanding the historical allocation and distribution of research funding advances our knowledge of how scientific research is supported across fields, institutions, and regions. However, large-scale analyses are hindered by the lack of comprehensive funder name disambiguation solutions, as funder names often exhibit spelling variations, translations, abbreviations, and inconsistent levels of granularity. In this paper, we present a framework for developing multilingual, multi-functional funder name disambiguation models and demonstrate its application to research publications in biodiversity conservation. To construct a training dataset, we integrated the Research Organization Registry (ROR), which provides unique identifiers for research organizations, with two publication datasets: the Web of Science (WoS) and the Crossref Open Funder Registry (OFR). We used multi-task learning with Contrastive Loss and Multiple Negatives Ranking Loss to fine-tune three open-weight embedding models from the Sentence Transformer, Gemma, and Qwen3 families. The best-performing models achieved accuracy above 0.90 when matching WoS funder names to ROR identifiers, outperforming general-purpose LLMs, including GPT-5.2, Claude-Sonnet-4.6, and Gemini-2.5-Flash, by more than 0.1. For funder names not indexed in ROR, we constructed a similarity network among funder names and identified clusters within it. Finally, we analyzed the disambiguation results and highlighted challenges arising from limited knowledge of smaller funders and funders from non-English-speaking countries. This work provides a reusable framework for funder name disambiguation with potential applicability across different model architectures and datasets, featuring cost-effective training data creation and multi-task learning and disambiguation.
2609.09984.paper_summary_zh: 了解研究資金的歷史分配和分配有助於我們認識科學研究在各個領域、機構和地區的支持情況。<lb/>然而，大規模分析受到缺乏全面的資助者名稱消歧義解決方案的阻礙，因為資助者名稱通常會出現拼寫變體、翻譯、縮寫和不一致的細節級別。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了一個開發多語言、多功能資助者名稱消歧義模型的框架，並展示其在生物多樣性保護研究出版物中的應用。<lb/>為了構建訓練數據集，我們將提供研究機構唯一標識符的研究機構註冊處（ROR）與兩個出版物數據集整合：科學網絡（WoS）和Crossref開放資助者註冊處（OFR）。<lb/>我們使用了對比損失和多負樣本排序損失的多任務學習來微調來自句子變換器、Gemma和Qwen3系列的三個開放權重嵌入模型。<lb/>表現最佳的模型在將WoS資助者名稱與ROR標識符進行匹配時達到了超過0.90的準確率，超過了包括GPT-5.2、Claude-Sonnet-4.6和Gemini-2.5-Flash在內的通用LLM超過0.1。<lb/>對於在ROR中未編入索引的資助者名稱，我們構建了資助者名稱之間的相似性網絡並識別了其中的聚類。<lb/>最後，我們分析了消歧義結果，並突出了來自對小型資助者和非英語國家的資助者知識有限所帶來的挑戰。<lb/>這項工作提供了一個可重用的資助者名稱消歧義框架，具有在不同模型架構和數據集中的潛在應用，特點是成本效益高的訓練數據創建和多任務學習及消歧義。
